<result>Both fixes are landed and committed. Report:

## Changes

**Fix 1 — gap XX (boot void):**
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/stage/mapPaint.ts:137-145` — new exported `ensureMapSeeded(overrides = {}, zones = [])`: guards on `mapHostLive()` (returns false so callers retry), then exact extracted behavior — `if (mapChunkCount() === 0 && !mapLoadFile(EDITOR_MAP_FILE)) mapGrowChunk(0,0)` + `mapSetGroundLook` + `mapRoadSetKinds` + `mapSetFloraSpecs`, plus one `[map-seed]` boot diagnostic warn.
- `mapPaint.ts:154` — `applyMapPaintEffects`'s arming branch now calls `ensureMapSeeded(next.tileMaterialOverrides, next.zones)` (no behavior change when arming).
- `/home/siah/creative/reactjit/cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx:144-159` — boot effect calls `ensureMapSeeded()` with the same retry-until-door pattern as the camera boot push (32ms interval, 120 tries); import at line 34.

**Fix 2 — gap VV (frozen hover ghost):**
- `WorldViewport.tsx:306-340` — while `props.tool === 'place'` and a piece is armed, a self-terminating ~16ms setTimeout chain (the `panStep` shape) polls `g.getMouseX?.()/getMouseY?.()`, converts to pane-local via `rectRef`, re-snaps only inside the pane rect (snap cleared on leave), and skips `setSnap` when x/y/z/yaw/pieceId are unchanged (idle pointer = zero re-renders). Effect deps collapse `props.armed` to a boolean so unrelated re-renders don't churn the timer; loop tears down on disarm/tool change/unmount. The existing `onMove` path is untouched (still correct during drags).

Also committed: `WorldEditorSurface.tsx`'s pre-existing campaign hunks (req_2563 world-model unification), whole, as instructed.

## Verification (honest)

- Built: `SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor` — clean.
- Seeding proven in the shipped binary: headless boot stderr shows `[js.warn] [map-seed] ground seeded — 1 chunk(s) live` with zero user interaction — the boot-time seed path executes end-to-end host-side.
- Shot: `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-siah-creative-reactjit/a29bdf2b-cd53-4650-be3f-08a38fb3ab80/scratchpad/xx_boot.png` — **the slab does NOT appear; the viewport pane is uniform `#0d141f` (WorldViewport's own Box background), not even a sky gradient.** Root cause found and it is NOT the WGSL formula (the parallel UU fix 7ee89e86d already landed): `sdk/dependency-registry.json`'s `compiled-world` feature triggers only on `cart/hmsc-int/CompiledWorld.tsx` / `cart/hmsc-int/LoaderIsoView.tsx`, so `rjit ship editor` never emits `-Dhas-compiled-world` (verify: it's absent from the printed zig flags) and the shipped editor binary contains **no WorldLoader primitive at all** — `renderEmbedded` never runs, zero `[loader]` lines, `RJIT_LIVE_PROBE=1` injects nothing. The user's live sessions work because the dev host builds with the full flag set. The seeded slab will render there; it cannot render in any `rjit shot editor` until the registry gains a `cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx` trigger — a one-line registry fix that is outside my file ownership, flagged in the commit message for the supervisor.
- Ghost hover: cannot be driven headless (no mouse harness), verified by code-path reasoning as directed — the poll reads the same global mouse doors the wheel path already uses, feeds the same `resolveSnap → setSnap` pipeline the (working) capture-drag path uses, and mirrors the host paint beam's per-frame SDL poll + bounds check.
